settings.uapipro.desc: Uses the uapis.cn IP geolocation API to show locations on login-device records, etc. (e.g. 203.0.113.42 (ISP China, Province, City)). The API Key is stored encrypted; blank uses uapis.cn guest quota (rate-limited).
settings.emailQueue.desc: Notifications, password resets, email verification and other emails are sent asynchronously via the Redis queue (auto-retry 3 times on failure) without blocking user requests; registration codes and SMTP test emails are sent synchronously (need instant feedback), and their failures count toward "Sync send failed". When Redis is not enabled it degrades to sync send automatically.
settings.network.cnameDesc: Configure a unified public domain so all VMs/containers are reached through it. Node names support Chinese, English and digits; the domain must start with . (e.g. .example.com) and the VMID is prepended automatically.
settings.ikuai.desc: Configure the iKuai router connection (used for DHCP lease lookup, port-forward sync, interface list, VLAN/subnet). Supports http and https; the password is stored encrypted and shown masked after saving; takes effect immediately without restart.
settings.clearCacheDesc: Clears all cached data in Redis and memory, including: user list, package list, device status, user activity status, JWT blacklist, unread messages, user profiles, site config, verification codes, password-reset tokens, rate-limit counters, etc.
settings.emailTpl.desc: Edit the email templates the system sends automatically. Click "Edit" to expand the editor, which supports rich text/source modes; click a "Available variable" to insert it at the cursor, and variable values are replaced automatically when sending. Takes effect immediately after saving; "Restore default" is available anytime.
settings.network.vlanDesc: VLAN names are generated by the system (prefixed with vlan_VPC + random characters, ≤15 chars) and cannot be edited; VLAN remarks record the owning user automatically. All config changes are logged.
settings.network.vlanIpStartHint: When a user creates a private network, the system takes the start range from here and increments +1 on the second-to-last octet (e.g. 172.16.0.1 → 172.16.1.1 → 172.16.2.1)
settings.emailTpl.richHint: Note: rich text mode does not support complex styles like buttons and alert blocks (some styles are simplified when opened; saving without changes is unaffected); switch to "Source" mode to keep or edit complex layouts.
settings.site.templateDesc: Choose the default UI template for the whole site. Click a card to preview it live; after saving it applies to all users without a personal preference (users can override it in User Center → Personal Settings).
settings.log.desc: User operation logs are kept per user, admin operation logs per site; when exceeding the limit, the oldest history is cleaned automatically (hourly). The two do not crowd each other out.
settings.network.dhcpDesc: This DNS is filled in automatically for private-network subnet DHCP servers. The service interface, gateway and address pool are generated automatically from the VLAN settings.
settings.uapipro.apiKeyHint: Issue one for free at uapis.cn/console; it is sent via the X-API-Key request header. Do not put the Key in the URL.
settings.pve.desc: Configure the connection info for the Proxmox VE server. The API Token and SSH password are stored encrypted and shown masked after saving.
settings.emailShell.desc: Customize the unified look of system emails (header banner/card/button/footer). Takes effect immediately after saving; all newly sent emails use the new style.
settings.redis.desc: Configure the Redis cache service. The password is stored encrypted; leaving the address blank disables Redis and all caches fall back to in-process memory.
settings.pve.tlsHint: Turn this off when PVE uses a self-signed certificate. When enabled, TLS certificates for PVE API and VNC connections are verified.
settings.pay.v1Hint: MD5-signature API based on submit.php / mapi.php / api.php
settings.emailShell.cssHint: CSS source appended to the end of the email <style>
settings.ikuai.tlsHint: Turn this off when iKuai uses a self-signed certificate (off by default). When enabled, TLS certificates for HTTPS connections are verified.
settings.ikuai.hostHint: Must include the protocol (http:// or https://) and port; blank disables iKuai sync
settings.pay.v2Hint: RSA-SHA256-signature API based on /api/pay/*, requires the keys above
settings.uapipro.testDesc: Enter a public IP to verify the geolocation API works (direct call, bypassing the cache).
